test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__Their was a large snake__ found in the garden last evening.

options.text: There was not a large snake

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e., "There was a large snake".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence "Their was a large snake found in the garden last evening" is incorrect because "Their" is a possessive adjective, not appropriate for indicating existence or location.
 
• The correct word to use in this context is "There," which is used to indicate the existence of something or its location.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *There was a large snake found in the garden last evening.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• "**Their was the larger snake**" is incorrect as "Their" is a possessive adjective and "the larger snake" changes the meaning.
 
• "**There was the larger snake"** is incorrect as "the larger snake" implies a comparative which is unnecessary here.
 
• "**There was not a large snake**" changes the meaning of the sentence to indicate no snake was found.
 
 
 
• Using "There" correctly indicates the existence of something, ensuring clarity and grammatical correctness.
